comment: IDPico puts the scope claims (email, email_verified, name, given_name, family_name) in the ID token for the code flow, gated by the scopes granted, so that relying parties that only read the ID token (Kubernetes, most proxies) get them; OIDC Core 5.4 says they belong in UserInfo. Deliberate and switchable per client (minimal_id_token); see CONFORMANCE.md.

IDPico puts the scope claims (email, email_verified, name, given_name, family_name) in the ID token for the code flow, gated by the scopes granted, so that relying parties that only read the ID token (Kubernetes, most proxies) get them; OIDC Core 5.4 says they belong in UserInfo. Deliberate and switchable per client (minimal_id_token); see CONFORMANCE.md.
IDPico has name, given_name and family_name only; the suite expects all fourteen profile claims (picture, locale, birthdate, ...). Unsupported claims.
The claims request parameter is not supported (claims_parameter_supported=false), so name is only released for scope profile.
No authentication context classes; acr_values is ignored and no acr claim is returned (SHOULD).
